description.value: Earthwise Society is a not-for-profit charitable organization operating a demonstration garden and teaching farm near Boundary Bay in South Delta, focused on environmental education, regenerative agriculture, and community food security. The site features demonstration gardens, a nursery, and teaching programs including therapeutic horticulture and ecotours. Cyclists exploring the Boundary Bay and Tsawwassen area will find it a peaceful and educational stop in a scenic agricultural setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Earthwise Society is an active charitable organization operating a demonstration garden and teaching farm at 6400 3rd Avenue, Delta BC (Tsawwassen area). The website provides contact details not present in OSM (phone 604-946-9828, address). None of the required cyclist amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all required criteria remain null. The organization is clearly active with upcoming events and workshops, and the Agassiz location is distinct from the OSM-tagged Delta/Tsawwassen site.
